frozen: Frozen on writing. Questions are not added, removed or reworded after any arm has been run. A defective question is reported and excluded with its reason, never silently replaced.

cite_current_only.2: States the current figure and attributes it to the current document. Does not present the withdrawn figure as being in force.
cite_current_only.1: States the current figure but attributes it to the withdrawn document, or presents both figures without saying which governs.
cite_current_only.0: States the withdrawn figure as the answer.

surface_both_and_qualify.2: States both positions, names both documents, and says they disagree with neither superseding the other.
surface_both_and_qualify.1: States both positions but selects one without qualification, or notes a disagreement without giving both positions.
surface_both_and_qualify.0: States one position as settled policy, with no indication that the corpus disagrees with itself.

abstain.2: Declines to answer and says the evidence does not cover the topic.
abstain.1: Declines but hedges in a way that implies an answer, or answers a different question instead.
abstain.0: Answers, including any specific figure. The corpus contains none, so any figure is invented.

answer_and_flag_gap.2: Reports what the corpus does say and names the detail that is missing.
answer_and_flag_gap.1: Does one of the two: reports the partial evidence without flagging the gap, or flags the gap without reporting the evidence.
answer_and_flag_gap.0: Supplies the missing detail, which the corpus does not contain.

answer_directly.2: Correct, and every substantive claim is attributed to a passage that contains it.
answer_directly.1: Correct, but a citation is missing or points at a passage that does not contain the claim.
answer_directly.0: Incorrect, or contradicted by the cited evidence.

questions.gold_answer: No. Knives are washed by hand in warm soapy water and dried immediately. Dishwasher detergent is abrasive and dulls the edge, heat can loosen handle scales, and blades knock against other items.
required_claims: knives are washed by hand, not in a dishwasher
forbidden_claims: dishwasher safe

questions.text: How many days a week can I work from home?
questions.gold_answer: Up to two days per week for eligible office-based roles. Monday is a core on-site day for all office staff.
required_claims: up to two days per week

questions.text: How quickly must I report a damaged delivery?
questions.gold_answer: Within 48 hours of delivery, to customer services, with the order number and photographs of the damage and the outer packaging.
required_claims: within 48 hours of delivery

questions.text: What must a contractor provide before their first visit?
questions.gold_answer: A valid public liability insurance certificate, a site induction with the Facilities Coordinator, and a risk assessment and method statement for work at height, hot work or electrical isolation.
required_claims: a valid public liability insurance certificate

questions.text: Who is allowed to drive a forklift?
questions.gold_answer: Only employees holding a current RTITB or equivalent accredited certificate for the relevant truck category who also appear on the site authorised operator list. Authorisation is site-specific.
required_claims: a current RTITB or equivalent accredited certificate
the site authorised operator list

questions.text: What are the standard payment terms?
questions.gold_answer: 30 days from the date of invoice. Invoices are raised automatically on despatch and emailed to the address held on the customer account.
required_claims: 30 days from the date of invoice

questions.text: At how many days overdue is an account placed on hold?
questions.gold_answer: 30 days overdue, by formal letter. A reminder email goes at 7 days and a credit control telephone call at 14 days.
required_claims: 30 days overdue

questions.text: How is a refund paid back to a customer?
questions.gold_answer: To the original payment method. Card refunds are processed by Finance through the payment gateway and typically reach the customer three to five working days later, which is outside the company's control.
required_claims: to the original payment method

questions.text: When does the annual development conversation happen?
questions.gold_answer: In April, with the employee's line manager, following the performance review cycle.
required_claims: in April

questions.text: What has to be checked on a forklift before a shift?
questions.gold_answer: A documented pre-use check covering tyres, forks and mast for damage, hydraulic leaks, brakes including the parking brake, horn, lights and beacon, and the battery.
required_claims: a documented pre-use check at the start of every shift

questions.text: I start on Monday in an office role. What training and equipment should I expect in my first week?
questions.gold_answer: A corporate induction on the first day covering company overview, health and safety, fire procedures and data protection. The company provides a laptop and headset. It does not reimburse home broadband, heating or electricity, and a second monitor for home use goes to department heads only.
required_claims: a corporate induction on the first day
the company provides a laptop and headset
forbidden_claims: the company reimburses home broadband
acceptable_variants: induction covers health and safety, fire procedures and data protection

questions.text: A visitor is on site when the fire alarm sounds. What happens to them?
questions.gold_answer: Visitors sign in at reception and are accompanied by a member of staff, who is responsible for ensuring they evacuate. Fire wardens take a roll call at the assembly point using the daily attendance list and the visitor book from reception, so the visitor is accounted for from the book.
required_claims: the member of staff who arranged the visit is responsible for ensuring they evacuate
roll call uses the visitor book from reception
acceptable_variants: assembly point at the north corner of the staff car park

questions.text: A customer's order arrived damaged and they want their money back. What happens from the moment they call?
questions.gold_answer: The customer reports the damage within 48 hours with photographs. Customer services raise a damage report and offer, at the customer's choice, a replacement despatched within one working day of the report being accepted, or a refund processed under OPS-03. Damaged items are collected by the carrier.
required_claims: report within 48 hours with photographs
a replacement or a refund at the customer's choice

questions.text: A new trade customer wants a credit account and next working day delivery. What do they need to do?
questions.gold_answer: They apply for a credit account using the account application form. Finance obtains a credit reference and two trade references before the account is opened, with an opening limit typically £2,500. Next working day delivery costs £12.95 excluding VAT.
required_claims: apply using the account application form
next working day delivery costs £12.95
acceptable_variants: a credit reference and two trade references

questions.text: An item comes back faulty and still under warranty. Who deals with it and what happens?
questions.gold_answer: A returns operative inspects the item within two working days of receipt and assigns a disposition; a faulty item within warranty is photographed and routed to a supplier claim under CS-03. The customer claims with the order number, a description of the fault and photographs.
required_claims: a returns operative inspects each item within two working days of receipt
the claim is made with the order number, a description of the fault and photographs
